 Robert Pattinson Officially Cast As James Bond For ‘Bond 26,’ Plus First Look As 007
 By Christopher Marc 
 November 16, 2026 10:16 am 
 0 
 37 
 Facebook X Pinterest WhatsApp 
 It has been made official that Robert Pattinson has taken over the James Bond role from previous actor Daniel Craig ; that key announcement was made by Amazon MGM Studios today , and it ends YEARS of speculation and endless rumors about who would land the top gig for “ Bond 26 ” and would be working with director Denis Villeneuve . The British actor was revealed last weekend as one of five actors who landed screen tests alongside Callum Turner , Jack Lowden , Nicholas Hoult and Josh O’Connor . 
 Of course, Villeneuve and Pattinson had recently worked together on next month’s “ Dune: Part Three ,” so this will be a reunion for the pair, as it looks like the actor has signed on for a trilogy of films, as Puck News previously reported after giving one of the big signs that Pattinson had landed the part last week by alluding to him being the true frontrunner, which is now confirmed to be the case. 
 READ MORE: Denis Villeneuve Vows To “Honor” The James Bond Legacy: “We Cannot F*ck It Up” 
 “Today, Amazon MGM Studios announced that Robert Pattinson will take on the iconic role of James Bond in the studio’s highly anticipated film, ushering in a new era for one of cinema’s most celebrated characters.”
 “James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honor of a lifetime. I’m deeply grateful to Denis, Amy, David, Tanya, and everyone at Amazon MGM Studios for their belief in me. To say this role is a dream come true is an understatement. I couldn’t be more excited about this partnership and the work ahead with this fantastic team,” Pattinson said in an official statement from Amazon. 
 Villeneuve also had some choice words about the casting, “Before anything else, I want to express my deep gratitude to the remarkable actors who joined us on this journey. We were surrounded by extraordinary talent, but there can only be one 007. I am overjoyed to welcome Robert Pattinson as our new James Bond. He has the timeless soul of 007 and brings a spirit that is completely new. I cannot wait to begin.”
 This marks the next generation of the James Bond franchise, and Villeneuve will be directing from a script penned by Steven Knight , with producers Amy Pascal and David Hayman being handpicked by Amazon MGM Studios to oversee the film’s production (possibly more if things work out). Tanya Lapointe is also serving as an executive producer on the pic. There had been some previous apprehension from former production company EON Productions , as they had wanted to court Pattinson for the part a while back. When he landed the lead in Matt Reeves’ “The Batman,” there had been reluctance to consider him because he was already associated with another big studio franchise character; well, that isn’t a problem for the new guard at Amazon. 
 Lastly, a statement from the producing duo: “James Bond is one of the most beloved, inspiring, iconic, and yet enigmatic characters in literature and movies. The legacy of this character is in great hands with Robert Pattinson. His fearlessness as an actor, his self-deprecating wit, and his ability to continually reinvent himself make him the perfect Bond for our times.”

 What we don’t currently know is WHEN the movie will be coming to theaters, so stay tuned for further updates on “Bond 26” and who else they end up casting in roles opposite Pattinson. They also included a first-look still of Pattinson as 007, which you can view below.
